svg.title: The sign-in window
svg.desc: - The list shows each site in the sites file and whether it is signed in: Signed in, Signed out, or Couldn't check (its tooltip gives the reason, such as HTTP 503). It checks without showing any page: a cookie site by its cookie in the store, a probe site by a request for its probe path in a view that is never shown, cancelled as soon as the status is known (a redirect counts as signed out), and a site with neither by its login page, loaded in such a view and watched until the site moves it on into itself or keeps it at a sign-in step (sites.md). Sign In asks the same way first, so a site you're signed in to never opens. It checks again each time the window is shown, and when the window comes to the front more than 30 seconds after the last check.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
